_doc: Motedis' slot nut with a spring (Nutenstein mit Feder) for its B-type 8 mm slot, M5. Also sold in M3. Motedis gives no hold.
name: slot-nut-8-motedis-m5-roll-in

slot.rule: Motedis' B-type 8 mm slot, which is Rexroth's (slot-8-bosch): Motedis sells B-type profiles to Rexroth's dimensions

thread.rule: Thread M5, sold as M4, M5, M6, M8

nut_kind.rule: Swivelled in through the opening after assembly; a leaf spring holds it in an upright beam

length.rule: Along the slot: 16 on the drawing
length.source: Motedis, Nutenstein mit Feder B Typ Nut 8 M5 (S8BSSNM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S8BSSNM5-Drawing_1.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Nutenstein-mit-Feder-B-Typ-Nut-8-M5

width.rule: Across the slot: 11,6 on the drawing
width.source: Motedis, Nutenstein mit Feder B Typ Nut 8 M5 (S8BSSNM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S8BSSNM5-Drawing_1.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Nutenstein-mit-Feder-B-Typ-Nut-8-M5

height.rule: The body under the lips: 3,6 on the drawing (its leaf spring reaches 9,8 below the top)
height.source: Motedis, Nutenstein mit Feder B Typ Nut 8 M5 (S8BSSNM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S8BSSNM5-Drawing_1.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Nutenstein-mit-Feder-B-Typ-Nut-8-M5

tongue_width.rule: Width of the step that stands in the opening, on the drawing
tongue_width.source: Motedis, Nutenstein mit Feder B Typ Nut 8 M5 (S8BSSNM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S8BSSNM5-Drawing_1.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Nutenstein-mit-Feder-B-Typ-Nut-8-M5

tongue_height.rule: Height of that step, on the drawing
tongue_height.source: Motedis, Nutenstein mit Feder B Typ Nut 8 M5 (S8BSSNM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S8BSSNM5-Drawing_1.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Nutenstein-mit-Feder-B-Typ-Nut-8-M5

nut_entry.rule: Put in through the opening anywhere along the slot

material.rule: Material as the product page names it

hold.rule: Rexroth rates its swivel-in block with a spring in an 8 mm slot (M8) at 2200 N. An estimate until it is tested (Frames 2.13): the maker gives no figure for this nut
hold.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4 to 3-9; the proof stress from the kit's m5 thread set (ISO 898-1)
